page.content:
Legendary Ethiopian goatherd who noticed dancing goats at coffee shrubs.

How Kaldi connects

  • Location: Ethiopia — The Kaldi legend is set among Ethiopian coffee shrubs.
  • Item: Coffea arabica — Kaldi is the folktale attached to the discovery of Arabica cherries.

What is Kaldi?

Kaldi is the origin folktale, not a documented planter: goats ate cherries, grew lively, and a monk — in most tellings — tried the fruit. The story marks Ethiopia as mythic source.

Key threads lead to Ethiopia and Coffea arabica.
